data.why: The app bundles stations.json (its one real data file, served from the repo root) and ships two real ARRO-format rainfall CSVs under data/demo/ for the Plots/ARRO Launcher CSV-import workflow, so no synthetic data is needed.

goals: Load the station and repeater dataset and confirm it renders correctly on the Stations map
Inspect a repeater's pass-range coverage to see which field stations it serves
Trace the signal path a station's readings take from field station through repeater(s) to a base station
Run an elevation profile and Longley-Rice link-budget/fade-margin check between two points on a radio path
Identify under-served or orphaned stations (ones with no repeater pass-range link) on the Pass Ranges tab
Import a CSV of logger readings (ARRO export) and plot/inspect the time series for a station's sensor

review.summary: The tree captures the planner's main work well: repeater coverage, finding orphaned stations and isolated repeaters, terrain and link-budget checks, and filtering and charting logger CSVs, and every screen I sampled matches its node. It needs fixes before filing: t6 calls the Bit Flipper a route tracer, which it is not; the README's stated jobs of following a station's route to a base and exporting to Radio Mobile are missing; and there are a few duplicate or noisy nodes.
